name: thrift
description: Sends cheap work to cheaper models: read-only subagents to haiku, trivial and routine turns to haiku or sonnet, with a per-request ledger that counts cache misses.

maxContextTokens.title: Context ceiling for rerouting
maxContextTokens.description: A main-conversation turn whose context already holds more than this many tokens stays on your chosen model (a switch would rewrite that whole context into the cheaper model's cache).

haikuAgents.title: Subagent types sent to haiku
haikuAgents.description: Comma-separated read-only subagent types (search, exploration, docs lookup) that run on haiku unless the call names a model itself.
